title: Cancellation Fee Relief for Holders Who Stay with Kestrel
content:
**Term.** The cancellation fee on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan is reduced for a holder who stays with Kestrel; the fee charged is the cancellation fee the cancellation carries, times the holder's fee share:

- where the covered vehicle was traded in to Kestrel toward another Kestrel purchase order that has been handed over, the holder pays the trade-in fee share of 50 percent;
- where the covered vehicle was not traded in to Kestrel but the holder has another Kestrel purchase order handed over and still delivered, the holder pays the repeat-buyer fee share of 75 percent;
- otherwise the holder pays the whole fee.

## Records read

- **Trade-in:** a Trade-In Agreements agreement whose vehicle is the plan's VIN, and the purchase order it is linked to.
- **Handed over:** that purchase order's status on the Vehicle Purchase Agreements record is delivered or completed.
- **Another order still delivered:** a purchase order of the holder for a different vehicle whose status is delivered.

| Covered vehicle traded in to Kestrel | Order it went toward handed over | Another order of the holder still delivered | Fee share |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes (delivered or completed) | any | 50 percent |
| yes | no | any | 100 percent |
| no | — | yes | 75 percent |
| no | — | no | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* on a fee of 50.00, a holder whose covered car went in trade toward a newer car already delivered pays 25.00; a holder who sold the covered car elsewhere but has a second Kestrel car delivered pays 37.50.
